lan_server_options.title: Advanced LAN options
lan_server_options.online_mode.tooltip: Verifies accounts with Mojang's servers. Turning it off permits unauthenticated names.
lan_server_options.whitelist.tooltip: Only allows players added to the whitelist to join.
lan_server_options.pvp.tooltip: Allows players to damage each other.
lan_server_options.offline_warning: Disabling online mode allows players to impersonate names.
lan_server_options.motd.refresh_failed: The LAN announcement could not be updated; reopen the LAN server.
